course.title: Computer Graphics I
course.description: Documenting the projects and assignments completed for Computer Graphics I, including goals, process, results, and demos for each project.

projects.title: Homework 2 - First Rendering Algorithm
projects.summary: For homework2 I applied my first rendering algorithm in HTML and JavaScript.
projects.goals: The goal was to render a 3D cube by applying the pinhole camera perspective to create a 2D image. Additionally, provide moving camera views by key press.
projects.process: I applied simple 3D projection math using the camera vertices and cube vertices to display a cube.
projects.result: I learned how to render a cube and implement different camera movements within a canvas.
